<!-- A new theme or a change to one. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

**Theme:** `directory-name`  **Version:** `x.y.z`

What it looks like, or what this changes:

- [ ] `go run ./check` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] `version` in `theme.json` is raised (a change to a theme that is here)
- [ ] Nothing is loaded from another host, and no script sends anything anywhere but `/info`
- [ ] Opened on a panel in `en`, `fa`, `ru` and `zh`, at phone width
- [ ] `preview.png` shows the theme as it is now
- [ ] Everything in it may be released under MIT
